Name: Meshelemiah, Son of Kore
Summary: Son of Kore, of the sons of Asaph, head of the divisions of the porters.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 26:1; 1 Chronicles 26:14: Son of Kore, of the sons of Asaph, head of the divisions of the porters.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Meshelemiah stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
